title: nutritious new middle eastern beans fatteh
description: bitter, pillowy, comforting middle-eastern dish featuring baked beans, wok-hei, whole30-friendly

ingredients.name: wok hei sauce
ingredients.notes: or substitute with a mixture of soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sesame oil

instructions: heat the ghee or avocado oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
add the chopped onion and cook until caramelized, about 15 minutes.
add the chickpeas, parsley, salt, and pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
cook for an additional 5 minutes, until the flavors have melded together.
transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with additional parsley if desired.
bake in a preheated oven at 37518 f for 15 minutes.
remove from the oven and drizzle with wok hei sauce.
serve warm, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
